key_facts: L'Oréal CEO Nicolas Hieronimus said the rise in GLP-1 weight loss drug use is "having an impact on beauty consumption and skin care consumption in particular"; he described GLP-1s as "a very important phenomenon for us" and said the beauty market was proving resilient in a challenging global context.

L'Oréal reported that sales in the three months to September rose by 7.7%, above analyst expectations. L'Oréal designs products from brands such as SkinCeuticals and Kiehl's to address skin sagging and other effects of rapid weight loss.

L'Oréal increased its stake in dermatology firm Galderma to 20% last December. Per Reuters, both companies have been testing products on GLP-1 users concerned about loose skin in separate clinical trials.
A Galderma survey of weight loss medication users found the vast majority had noticed changes to their facial appearance after using those drugs.
importance_reason: Корпоративная новость о влиянии тренда на отдельный сегмент потребления; квартальный рост 7.7% выше ожиданий, но без системного рыночного эффекта.
market_link: Тренд GLP-1 препаратов может перераспределять потребительские расходы из косметики и ухода за кожей в сторону других категорий; для акций L'Oréal и Galderma — возможный фактор роста выручки в этом сегменте.

key_facts: Optimum Communications is preparing to file for chapter 11 bankruptcy.

market_link: Possible pressure on the company's bonds and loans, and read-across to leveraged-credit sentiment in US telecom/cable debt.

key_facts: NESO said Britain's electricity system is prepared and resilient for winter, and that supplies are expected to remain secure, though 'tight days' are possible; such days would lead to notices to power producers that additional generation may be needed, which NESO says is routine and not a warning of power cuts.
National Gas expects sufficient gas supply to meet demand this winter, but forecasts gas-for-power generation to rise at peak demand due to the 'intermittent' nature of renewables.

An independent investigation by Eversheds Sutherland found 'high levels of stress and concern' in NESO's Electricity National Control Centre about the state of the energy industry and the ability to keep supply balanced, and found a 'significant disconnect' between control room staff and NESO leadership; it did not substantiate whistle-blower allegations but identified 'cultural, governance and control issues'.
Wind was Britain's largest electricity generation source last year at almost 30% of all power, marginally above gas.
importance_reason: Winter grid-security outlook plus an internal governance probe at the system operator; relevant to UK energy sector but no immediate market-moving decision.
market_link: Gas-for-power demand at winter peaks could affect UK gas prices and power market sentiment; the effect is indirect and uncertain.

key_facts: Lillian Droniak, 96 years old, from Connecticut, has about 15 million TikTok followers; she went viral in June after claiming her retirement home threatened to evict her for hosting parties, and the home later confirmed the threat before reaching a settlement that allowed her to keep partying without serving alcohol.

Droniak's social media income covers her nursing home fees of $12,000 (£9,000) a month; part of the earnings goes to a college fund for her great-grandchildren; her grandson edits her sponsored content, which includes food and beauty brand partnerships.

Other older creators featured: Viv Truran, 82, from Cardiff, posts two videos a day, does a couple of sponsored posts a month, and has turned down some big deals; Grace Geramita, 85, known as Nonna Gracie, earns more from cooking videos than from any previous job; Barbara Costello, 77, former teacher, shares cooking and homemaking content.

Naomi Baker of We Are Social says older creators are attractive to brands because they have 'deeply established, highly loyal' communities with greater purchasing power, which 'carries a massive premium'.
importance_reason: Лайфстайл/соцсети без прямого рыночного эффекта; экономическая составляющая ограничена монетизацией отдельных креаторов.
